name: Heatwave: Sam's Stay
source:
The last thing Sam expected during his final summer before university was to end up staying at Michael’s house, his mom’s ex-husband. A man he hadn’t seen in over ten years and didn’t have the fondest memories of. What was meant to be a short stay quickly becomes something far more complicated, when old resentment meets unexpected curiosity.

As Sam meets new people and struggles with unfamiliar thoughts, one thing becomes clear: this trip isn’t just about getting by, it’s about discovering what he really desires.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103530/Heatwave_Sams_Stay/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
山姆在大学前的最后一个夏天最没想到的就是最终会住在他母亲的前夫迈克尔的家里。一个十几年没见，也没有最美好的回忆的男人。当旧日的怨恨遇到意想不到的好奇心时，原本短暂的停留很快就变得更加复杂。

当山姆结识新朋友并与陌生的想法作斗争时，有一件事变得清晰：这次旅行不仅仅是为了度过难关，而是为了发现他真正想要的东西。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4103530/Heatwave_Sams_Stay/]Steam[/url]]
